hero.title: Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society
hero.subtitle: One of the oldest organizations in Uzbekistan, dedicated to humanitarian aid, emergency response, and community service since 1925.

about.label: About Us
about.title: A Legacy of Compassion
about.description: The Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society has been serving the people of Uzbekistan for nearly a century. As part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, we are committed to protecting human life and health, and to ensuring respect for all human beings.
about.intro_society: As one of the oldest humanitarian organizations, the society unites thousands of volunteers across all regions, operating a network of regional offices, a training center, and numerous programs in first aid, blood donation, emergency response, and community service.

academy.title: Republican Training & Methodological Center
academy.intro: The Republican Training and Methodological Center is a unified training and methodological institution of the Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society, established by decision of the Society's Presidium No. 7/2 of July 7, 2000. It is the only center of this format among National Red Crescent Societies in Central Asia.
academy.dir_1: Training, preparation and retraining of Society staff and volunteers, improving qualifications in the main areas of the Society's charter, including first aid training, emergency preparedness and response, knowledge about the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement and International Humanitarian Law.
academy.dir_2: Assisting in organizing and holding seminars, trainings, presidium meetings and other events of the Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society and partner organizations.
academy.dir_3: Organizing charity, cultural and sports events with the participation of Society volunteers, the population and young people.
academy.dir_4: Providing methodological, consultative and practical assistance to the Society's organizations, generalizing the experience of the best organizations and introducing effective working methods.
academy.dir_5: Supporting the development and implementation of innovative programs and projects within the charter's objectives, and developing the Center's material, technical and financial base.
academy.dir_6: Cooperating with international, state and non-governmental organizations, private companies and agencies to support the Society's humanitarian activities.
academy.infra_desc_1: The Center is an 8-storey building with a total area of more than 4000 square meters, where all necessary conditions for effective training and holding various events have been created. Every year, from 500 to 1500 people are trained at the Center.
academy.infra_desc_2: With the support of the Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society, the Center is equipped with modern office and thematic equipment, including modern first aid mannequins, simulation materials, technical equipment for emergencies and other types of training equipment.
academy.infra_desc_3: The building has two conference halls - a small hall for 30 listeners and a large hall for more than 100 people. On the second and third floors there is a hotel complex accommodating 50 people in 14 rooms with LED TVs, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi, and on the lower floor - a dining room and buffet.
